thesis.title: Why <cool>collective intelligence</cool> matters
thesis.description: Market knowledge is distributed. No single vantage point holds enough of it to price a frontier-market opportunity alone.
thesis.pivot: Different people hold different pieces of investment-relevant evidence. Kori structures those contributions into an auditable decision record.

solution.title: Capital becomes <cool>architecture</cool>
solution.description: Diaspora investors pool capital and co-invest through smart contracts and stablecoin settlement. Every transaction traceable, every milestone visible.
solution.accent: Prosperity emerges when knowledge flows together.
